name_reason: Follows data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> with domain=battle (core battle/progression counter). Descriptor 'pending_xp_credit' accurately reflects a pending experience accumulator and its 32-bit counter datatype. No Ghidra address residue ('xp' is not hex; no trailing self/data address). The READ/WRITE xref pattern (damage/heal/spell appliers accumulate; fd2_process_xp_and_level_up_for_char drains and zeroes) matches the name exactly.
purpose: Battle-wide pending experience accumulator: combat/spell/item appliers add an action's earned XP into this cell; the level-up handler later drains it to drive level-up and then resets it to 0.
logic_summary: Lifecycle per player action: (1) action dispatcher resets it to 0 (fd2_game_main_loop / fd2_player_inline_action_menu_dispatch) at action start; (2) damage/heal/status/spell appliers accumulate per-action XP (e.g. fd2_apply_damage_and_award_xp: ADD [0x53EC8],EAX with enemy_xp*level scaled by damage; in-file spell casts add level_mod*N / base_dmg*10 / status_value*8; physical combat formula fd2_execute_attack_damage_calculation sets it on a player kill); (3) dispatcher clamps it to <=99; (4) fd2_process_xp_and_level_up_for_char gates on (!=0), adds it plus the carried per-char remainder (bMovement_order) to drive the >=100-per-level loop, mirrors the value into data_fd2_dialog_last_action_value_param for the 'gained N XP' dialog, then resets it to 0. Chapter-event handlers (1e, 37) also write scripted credits.
element_semantics: Single 32-bit scalar holding a non-negative running experience-point total. Accessed exclusively as a full dword (ADD/MOV dword ptr [0x53EC8]); used unsigned. Per-kill XP = enemy_xp_value * level products are summed, so it can exceed 255 before the dispatcher clamps it to 99. Zero-initialized at load (BSS); first touch on every path is a write, so it carries no static seed.
notes: Data symbol (no function at address). Ghidra had no data PLATE_COMMENT at 0x53EC8 (verified null); created a concise plate via run_script_inline + cu.setComment(PLATE_COMMENT,...) aligned with the src comment conclusion (src comment was already accurate and concise -> kept, no src edit). is_const=false confirmed by extensive game write-xrefs. Datatype/semantics verified across readers (fd2_process_xp_and_level_up_for_char) and writers (fd2_apply_damage_and_award_xp, fd2_execute_attack_damage_calculation, fd2_game_main_loop clamp). No src .c edit this round; only the shard is staged/committed.
